```{r}
library(tidyverse)
read.csv("Cor Datasheet - combine vs hand 2025.csv") -> dat

```

# Rosemount

Date = 2025-10-31

Site = Rosemount, R22 and R34 Field

Methods = Harvested 43 ft of 2 rows at 30" row spacing in 6 adjacent corn rows. Moisture and test weight were estimated two ways...

1.  using the HarvestMaster system on combine and

2.  using a Perten 5200 on a subsample immediately afterwards

Does rosemount combine accurately determine moisture and test weight compared to benchtop equipment?

Data

Testweight = good. with 0.5 lbs per bushel.

Moisture = ok, within 1.5 - 2 moisture %

Discussion

The corn was bagged and driven back (1hr) in bed of truck during a light drizzle which could possibly have slightly increased moisture. When brought back to campus, they were put in dryer for 30 min, then analyzed.

```{r defining dat1}
dat %>% 
  mutate(moisture = moisture....,
         testweight = test.weight..lb.bu.) %>% 
  mutate(method = fct_recode(method, 
                             "Perten 5200" = "by hand",
                             "HarvestMaster on combine" = "combine")) %>% 
  mutate(location = if_else(date=="2025-10-31", "rosemount", "st paul")) -> dat1 

 
```

## moisture

```{r}

dat1 %>% 
  filter(date=="2025-10-31") %>%
  ggplot(aes(method, moisture,
             group = site,
             linetype = site)) + 
  # stat_summary() +
  geom_jitter(width = .1) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean, 
    geom = "line"  ) +
  labs(y="moisture (%)",
       x="
       ")

```

## test weight

```{r}
dat1 %>% 
  filter(date=="2025-10-31") %>%
  ggplot(aes(method, testweight)) +
  geom_jitter(width = .1) +
  labs(y="test weight (lb / bu)",
       x="")
```

## data

### raw

```{r}

dat1 %>% 
  filter(date=="2025-10-31") %>%
  select(site, position, method, moisture, testweight) %>% 
  arrange(site,position, method) %>% 
  knitr::kable()
```

### summarized

```{r}
dat1 %>% 
  filter(date=="2025-10-31") %>%
  select(site, position, method, moisture, testweight) %>% 
  arrange(site,position, method) %>% 
  group_by(site, method) %>% 
  summarise(moisture_mean = mean(moisture),
            testweight_mean = mean(testweight)) %>% 
  select(-testweight_mean) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method, 
    values_from = moisture_mean) %>% 
  mutate(
      difference = `Perten 5200` - `HarvestMaster on combine`,
    ` %difference` = (`Perten 5200` - `HarvestMaster on combine`) / `Perten 5200`*100 ) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "moisture"
  )
```

```{r}
dat1 %>% 
  filter(date=="2025-10-31") %>%
  select(site, position, method, moisture, testweight) %>% 
  arrange(site,position, method) %>% 
  group_by(site, method) %>% 
  summarise(moisture_mean = mean(moisture),
            testweight_mean = mean(testweight)) %>% 
  select(-moisture_mean) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method, 
    values_from = testweight_mean) %>% 
  mutate(
    difference = `Perten 5200` - `HarvestMaster on combine`,
    ` %difference` = (`Perten 5200` - `HarvestMaster on combine`) / `Perten 5200`*100 ) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "test weight"
  )
```

# Variety performance (combine data only)

```{r}

read.csv("C:/Users/jpuka/Downloads/Cor Datasheet - data_2024+2025.csv") -> trt_list

trt_list %>% 
  filter(date=="10/21/2025") %>% 
  # mutate(location = "st paul") %>% 
  select(site, name, plot) -> trt_list_sp

trt_list %>% 
  filter(date=="10/22/2025") %>% 
  # mutate(location = "rosemount") %>% 
  select(site, name, plot) %>% 
  mutate(plot = str_sub(site, -3L)) %>% 
  mutate(plot = str_to_lower(plot)) %>% 
  select(-site) %>%
  mutate(site = "rosemount") %>% 
  slice(1,5)-> trt_list_rsmt


dat1 %>% 
  mutate(plot = site, 
         site = location) %>% 
  select(site, plot, yield..bu.acre., moisture, testweight) %>% 
  drop_na(yield..bu.acre.) %>% 
  left_join(trt_list_sp) %>% 
  filter(site == "st paul") -> trt_dat_sp

dat1 %>% 
  mutate(plot = site, 
         site = location) %>% 
  select(site, plot, yield..bu.acre., moisture, testweight) %>% 
  drop_na(yield..bu.acre.) %>% 
  left_join(trt_list_rsmt) %>% 
  filter(site == "rosemount") -> trt_dat_rsmt

trt_dat_sp %>% 
  bind_rows(trt_dat_rsmt) -> dat_name


```

## Yield

```{r}
dat_name %>% 
  mutate(name = fct_reorder(name, yield..bu.acre.)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(name, yield..bu.acre.,
             col=site)) +
  geom_jitter(width = .1) +
  stat_summary(geom = "point", 
               fun = mean,
               col = 1,
               size = 4,
               shape = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(caption = "X indicates mean")
```

-   Just shows combine harvest, which is new in 2025. Hand harvest estimates not included

-   PR106-20ssc in rosemount was following alfalfa, may explain larger yield

-   Need to add on 2 meters of row for each st paul strip and get precise lengths
